known_discrepancies.finding: The frozen canonical triage universe is 58757 unique VAs while the live Ghidra function count is 59245.
known_discrepancies.interpretation: Treat the difference as scope and snapshot drift, not as an unresolved missing-row defect.
evidence: xrefs-2540f2ca.summary.json pins the canonical universe at 58757.
The same summary reports pinned_missing_at_address as 0.
The vtable artifact reports meta.functions as 58756.
known_discrepancies.remaining_gap: No row-level diff between the live Ghidra function set and the canonical ledger was performed in this inventory.

known_discrepancies.finding: SDK import reports 1666 rows and 1663 unique addresses, while narrative reports refer to 1670/1671 functions; older missing-entry reports refer to 1188, while the repaired adjudication reports 1186 after duplicate correction.
known_discrepancies.interpretation: Preserve both raw import counts and repaired adjudication counts; do not collapse them into one number.

known_discrepancies.finding: Older reports mention 96 KG nodes, 115 edges, and 14 tests, while the current read-only database contains 65461 nodes, 20397 edges, and 28 test results.
known_discrepancies.interpretation: The older figures describe an earlier phase and must not be used as current database counts.

known_discrepancies.finding: Older reports record 1895 structures, while current analysis reports 2035.
known_discrepancies.interpretation: Retain the phase-specific provenance for each structure count.

known_discrepancies.finding: The triage-v6 JSONL filename and summary identify triage-v6, but row classifier_version fields remain triage-v5.
known_discrepancies.interpretation: Use the artifact version and row metadata as separate evidence; do not silently normalize them.

known_discrepancies.finding: The canonical body set contains 478 addresses, while manifest and file counts contain 477 decompiler exports plus one annotated capture; one SDK-address duplicate explains the manifest/file difference.
known_discrepancies.interpretation: Use canonical address sets for coverage accounting and retain file-level provenance separately.
